data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian language, meaning 'beauty' or 'charm'. This name is often given to girls born into families who value inner and outer beauty. The name Roopma carries the meaning “Beauty, Charm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Roopma usually hope their child will grow to embody beauty, charm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
